name: compositionTimeline
description: Recent compositions with template, time, composer and identifier.
query: SELECT c/uid/value AS compositionUid, c/name/value AS compositionName, c/archetype_details/template_id/value AS templateId, c/context/start_time/value AS recordedAt, c/composer/name AS composer FROM EHR ehr[ehr_id/value = $ehrId] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 50

name: diagnosisHistory
description: Diagnosis compositions with diagnosis entry metadata.
query: SELECT c/uid/value AS compositionUid, c/context/start_time/value AS recordedAt, c/composer/name AS composer, d/name/value AS entryName, d/archetype_node_id AS archetypeId FROM EHR ehr[ehr_id/value = $ehrId] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS EVALUATION d WHERE c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_Diagnosis.v1.1.1' ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 25

name: procedureHistory
query: SELECT c/uid/value AS compositionUid, c/context/start_time/value AS recordedAt, c/composer/name AS composer, p/name/value AS entryName, p/archetype_node_id AS archetypeId FROM EHR ehr[ehr_id/value = $ehrId] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS ACTION p WHERE c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_Procedure.v1.1.0' ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 25

name: serviceRequests
query: SELECT c/uid/value AS compositionUid, c/context/start_time/value AS recordedAt, c/composer/name AS composer, i/name/value AS entryName, i/archetype_node_id AS archetypeId FROM EHR ehr[ehr_id/value = $ehrId] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS INSTRUCTION i WHERE c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_ServiceRequest.v1.1.1' ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 25

name: aktive-diagnosen-anzahl
query:
SELECT
  COUNT(c) AS anzahl
FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c
WHERE e/ehr_id/value = $ehrId
  AND c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_Diagnosis.v1.1.1'
  AND c/content[openEHR-EHR-EVALUATION.problem_diagnosis.v1 and name/value='primary diagnosis']/data[at0001]/items[openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER.problem_qualifier.v2]/items[at0003]/value/value = 'Active'

name: aktuelle-medikation
description: Alle Medikationseinträge eines Patienten (Name, Status, Dosierung, Indikation).
query:
SELECT
  c/content[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.medication_statement.v0]/data[at0001]/events[at0002]/data[at0003]/items[at0006]/value/value AS Medikament,
  c/content[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.medication_statement.v0]/data[at0001]/events[at0002]/data[at0003]/items[at0008]/value/value AS Status,
  c/content[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.medication_statement.v0]/data[at0001]/events[at0002]/data[at0003]/items[at0033]/value/value AS Dosierung,
  c/content[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.medication_statement.v0]/data[at0001]/events[at0002]/data[at0003]/items[at0023]/value/value AS Indikation
FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c
WHERE e/ehr_id/value = $ehrId AND c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_MedicationStatement.v1.1.0'

name: anordnungen-uebersicht
description: Alle ServiceRequests mit Leistung, Typ, Priorität, Indikation, Kommentar und bestätigtem Fälligkeitsdatum.
query: SELECT i/activities[at0001]/description[at0009]/items[at0121]/value/value AS Bezeichnung, i/activities[at0001]/description[at0009]/items[at0148]/value/value AS Leistungsart, i/activities[at0001]/description[at0009]/items[at0068]/value/value AS Dringlichkeit, i/activities[at0001]/description[at0009]/items[at0152]/value/value AS Indikation, i/activities[at0001]/description[at0009]/items[at0150]/value/value AS Kommentar, i/activities[at0001]/description[at0009]/items[at0040]/value/value AS FaelligAm FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS INSTRUCTION i WHERE e/ehr_id/value = $ehrId AND c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_ServiceRequest.v1.1.1'

name: diagnosen-uebersicht
description: Alle Diagnosen eines Patienten (Name, Beginn, Status, Sicherheit), neueste zuerst.
query:
SELECT
  c/content[openEHR-EHR-EVALUATION.problem_diagnosis.v1 and name/value='primary diagnosis']/data[at0001]/items[at0002]/value/value AS Diagnose,
  c/content[openEHR-EHR-EVALUATION.problem_diagnosis.v1 and name/value='primary diagnosis']/data[at0001]/items[at0077]/value/value AS Beginn,
  c/content[openEHR-EHR-EVALUATION.problem_diagnosis.v1 and name/value='primary diagnosis']/data[at0001]/items[openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER.problem_qualifier.v2]/items[at0003]/value/value AS Status,
  c/content[openEHR-EHR-EVALUATION.problem_diagnosis.v1 and name/value='primary diagnosis']/data[at0001]/items[at0073]/value/value AS Sicherheit
FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c
WHERE e/ehr_id/value = $ehrId AND c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_Diagnosis.v1.1.1'
ORDER BY c/content[openEHR-EHR-EVALUATION.problem_diagnosis.v1 and name/value='primary diagnosis']/data[at0001]/items[at0077]/value/value DESC

name: personCompositions
query: SELECT c/uid/value AS compositionUid, c/context/start_time/value AS recordedAt, c/composer/name AS composer, p/name/value AS entryName, p/archetype_node_id AS archetypeId FROM EHR ehr[ehr_id/value = $ehrId] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS ADMIN_ENTRY p WHERE c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_Person.v1.1.1' ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 25

name: param_check
query: SELECT c/uid/value AS uid FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c WHERE e/ehr_id/value = $ehrId LIMIT 5

name: sanity_check
query: SELECT e/ehr_id/value AS ehrId FROM EHR e LIMIT 2

name: analyteResults
description: Multi-column analyte values including LOINC code, magnitude and unit.
query: SELECT c/uid/value AS compositionUid, c/context/start_time/value AS recordedAt, a/items[at0001]/value/value AS analyteName, a/items[at0001]/value/defining_code/code_string AS loincCode, a/items[at0024]/value/magnitude AS magnitude, a/items[at0024]/value/units AS unit FROM EHR ehr[ehr_id/value = $ehrId] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.laboratory_test_result.v1] CONTAINS CLUSTER a[openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER.laboratory_test_analyte.v1] ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 100

name: haemoglobin-trend
description: Zeitreihe der Hämoglobin-Messwerte eines Patienten, älteste zuerst.
query: SELECT a/items[at0001]/value/magnitude AS wert, a/items[at0001]/value/units AS einheit, a/items[at0006]/value/value AS zeitpunkt FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.laboratory_test_result.v1] CONTAINS CLUSTER a[openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER.laboratory_test_analyte.v1] WHERE e/ehr_id/value = $ehrId AND a/items[at0024]/value/value = 'Hämoglobin' ORDER BY a/items[at0006]/value/value ASC

name: labReportTimeline
description: Laboratory report compositions and observation metadata.
query: SELECT c/uid/value AS compositionUid, c/context/start_time/value AS recordedAt, c/composer/name AS composer, o/name/value AS entryName, o/archetype_node_id AS archetypeId FROM EHR ehr[ehr_id/value = $ehrId] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o WHERE c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_DiagnosticReportLab.v1.1.2' ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 25

name: recent-results
description: Alle Laborergebnisse eines Patienten (Analyt, Wert, Zeitpunkt), neueste zuerst.
query: SELECT a/items[at0024]/value/value AS analyt, a/items[at0001]/value/magnitude AS wert, a/items[at0001]/value/units AS einheit, a/items[at0006]/value/value AS zeitpunkt FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.laboratory_test_result.v1] CONTAINS CLUSTER a[openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER.laboratory_test_analyte.v1] WHERE e/ehr_id/value = $ehrId ORDER BY a/items[at0006]/value/value DESC

name: specimenHistory
query: SELECT c/uid/value AS compositionUid, c/context/start_time/value AS recordedAt, c/composer/name AS composer, s/name/value AS entryName, s/archetype_node_id AS archetypeId FROM EHR ehr[ehr_id/value = $ehrId] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS ACTION s WHERE c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_Specimen.v1.0.0' ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 25

name: administrationHistory
query: SELECT c/uid/value AS compositionUid, c/context/start_time/value AS recordedAt, c/composer/name AS composer, a/name/value AS entryName, a/archetype_node_id AS archetypeId FROM EHR ehr[ehr_id/value = $ehrId] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS ACTION a WHERE c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_MedicationAdministration.v1.0.2' ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 25

name: medicationStatements
query: SELECT c/uid/value AS compositionUid, c/context/start_time/value AS recordedAt, c/composer/name AS composer, m/name/value AS entryName, m/archetype_node_id AS archetypeId FROM EHR ehr[ehr_id/value = $ehrId] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS EVALUATION m WHERE c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_MedicationStatement.v1.1.0' ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 25

name: op-bericht-zusammenfassung
description: Letzter OP-Bericht eines Patienten (Eingriff, Indikation, Methode, Lokalisation, Ergebnis, OP-Datum) aus vg_Procedure.v1.1.0.
query:
SELECT
  c/uid/value AS compositionUid,
  c/context/start_time/value AS recordedAt,
  a/description[at0001]/items[at0002]/value/value AS Eingriff,
  a/description[at0001]/items[at0070]/value/value AS Indikation,
  a/description[at0001]/items[at0065]/value/value AS Methode,
  a/description[at0001]/items[at0063]/value/value AS Lokalisation,
  a/description[at0001]/items[at0048]/value/value AS Ergebnis,
  a/description[at0001]/items[at0066]/value/value AS OP_Datum
FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS ACTION a[openEHR-EHR-ACTION.procedure.v1]
WHERE e/ehr_id/value = $ehrId AND c/archetype_details/template_id/value = 'vg_Procedure.v1.1.0'
ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC

name: labverlauf-alle-parameter
description: Vollständiger strukturierter Polytrauma-Laborverlauf mit datiertem Panel, Analyt, Wert und Einheit.
query: SELECT o/data[at0001]/events[at0002]/data[at0003]/items[at0005]/value/value AS panel, a/items[at0024]/value/value AS analyt, a/items[at0001]/value/magnitude AS wert, a/items[at0001]/value/units AS einheit, c/context/start_time/value AS recordedAt FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS (OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.laboratory_test_result.v1] CONTAINS CLUSTER a[openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER.laboratory_test_analyte.v1]) WHERE e/ehr_id/value = $ehrId ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 500
